intro: You're going to teach a robot to tell circles from squares! Show it some shapes and tell it what they are.
trainInstructions: Tap the right name for each shape to teach the robot.
goodDataIntro: The robot learned from your answers. Let's see if it gets new shapes right!
goodDataExplain: The robot learned well because you gave it correct examples. Good examples make the robot smart!
badDataIntro: Now let's train another robot. This time, a distracted helper already labeled a few shapes before you got here — and mixed some up by accident!
badDataExplain: Did you notice? Some of the training shapes were mixed up (not your fault!). That's why the robot got confused and made more mistakes this time.
conclusion: This happens with every robot and computer that learns: if the examples we give them are wrong, they learn the wrong things. Good examples make smart robots!
